en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a crowded sandy beach in front of a modernist, flat‑roofed beach pavilion or bathhouse. Many people, mostly families in mid‑20th‑century swimwear, sit or lie on the sand and on deckchairs. Behind them is a long, low, rectilinear building with large windows, a terrace with railings and parasols, and three flagpoles flying light‑colored flags. Coniferous trees stand behind the structure. The photo is bordered by a light postcard-style frame.
